stubs.note: Peripheral output word area, indexed by byte address.

stubs.name: Program_Alarm
stubs.note: Siemens program alarm. SD_x are VARIANT in Siemens, but here they are typed UINT to match the calls.

stubs.name: RD_LOC_T
stubs.declaration:
FUNCTION RD_LOC_T : INT
VAR_IN_OUT
    OUT : DTL;
END_VAR
END_FUNCTION
stubs.note: Reads the local time. OUT is an output in Siemens but is declared IN_OUT here because the calls pass it by position.

stubs.name: RD_SINFO
stubs.note: SFC6, which reads the start information of the current OB and the last startup OB. The helper struct type is needed for the outputs.

stubs.name: RD_SYS_T
stubs.declaration:
FUNCTION RD_SYS_T : INT
VAR_OUTPUT
    OUT : DTL;
END_VAR
END_FUNCTION
stubs.note: Siemens instruction that reads the CPU system time (UTC) into the OUT output (DTL) and returns an error code. Called with one positional argument, which maps to OUT. In this stub, OUT and the return value stay zero.

stubs.name: READ_CLK
stubs.declaration:
FUNCTION READ_CLK : INT
VAR_IN_OUT
    CDT : DT;
END_VAR
END_FUNCTION
stubs.note: SFC1 reads the CPU clock into CDT. In Siemens CDT is an output. Here it is VAR_IN_OUT because the call site passes it with ':='. In this stub, CDT is left unchanged and the return value is 0.

stubs.name: READ_DBL
stubs.note: Siemens instruction that copies a data block in load memory (SRCBLK) to a block in work memory (DSTBLK), asynchronously. In this stub, RET_VAL, BUSY and DSTBLK stay zero.

stubs.name: RecipeExport
stubs.note: Siemens instruction that exports a recipe data block to a CSV file on the memory card. In Siemens RECIPE_DB is InOut. Here it is an input because the library writes it as a member. The outputs stay zero.

stubs.name: RecipeImport
stubs.note: Siemens instruction that imports a recipe CSV file from the memory card into a recipe data block. RECIPE_DB is declared as an input because the library writes it as a member. The outputs stay zero.

stubs.name: SB_DT_TM
stubs.note: STEP 7 IEC function FC35 subtracts the duration D from the date-and-time T. The body is left empty because DT minus TIME arithmetic may not compile in RuSTy, so the result is DT#1970-01-01-00:00:00.

stubs.name: STRING_TO_INT
stubs.declaration:
FUNCTION STRING_TO_INT : INT
VAR_INPUT
    IN : STRING[255];
END_VAR
END_FUNCTION
stubs.note: Converts a numeric string to INT. The body is left empty because the parsing details (spaces, sign, overflow) are not documented, so the result is 0.

stubs.name: STRNG_I
stubs.declaration:
FUNCTION STRNG_I : INT
VAR_INPUT
    S : STRING[254];
END_VAR

stubs.note: STEP 7 IEC function FC38 converts a string to INT. The body is left empty, so the result is 0.

stubs.name: TIME_TCK
stubs.declaration:
FUNCTION TIME_TCK : TIME
END_FUNCTION
stubs.note: SFC64 reads the CPU system time tick in ms. It takes no parameters. In this stub the result is T#0s.

stubs.name: TOD_TO_TIME
stubs.declaration:
FUNCTION TOD_TO_TIME : TIME
VAR_INPUT
    IN : TOD;
END_VAR
END_FUNCTION
stubs.note: Converts a time of day into a TIME duration since midnight. The body is left empty to avoid date-type arithmetic problems, so the result is T#0s.
